handback.title: Code checks the reviewer's required boxes
handback.summary: A review that skips a box, leaves a field out or approves past a blocking entry is rejected.
handback.user_story: A review that skips a duty, or claims a weak test without proof, is rejected before it posts.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a plan review or code review leaves out one of the six boxes, it is rejected, naming that box.
acceptance_criteria.words: Every box must be present at both stages.

edge_cases.case: A review with no boxes at all is rejected, naming the boxes.
A code review missing a box is rejected, as a plan review is.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a box entry leaves out a field its shape needs, the review is rejected, naming that field.

edge_cases.case: An added entry whose kind is neither creep nor needed is rejected, naming the kind.
A field left blank counts as left out.
An entry written as a bare line is rejected, naming its box.
An edges line naming no case, or reading neither covered nor missing, is rejected.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a weak test entry names no wrong code that still passes, the review is rejected.
acceptance_criteria.words: A weak-test claim without a named counterexample is rejected by code.

edge_cases.case: The wrong code is written as an empty or blank line.

acceptance_criteria.text: When a review approves while any box holds a blocking entry, it is rejected, naming that box.
acceptance_criteria.words: each entry a blocker unless noted

edge_cases.case: An edges line reading missing blocks an approve, like an entry in any other box.
A block holding the same entry still passes.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the added box holds only entries of kind needed, the review can still approve.

edge_cases.case: The same entry of kind creep still stops an approve.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the edges box leaves out a criterion of the plan, the review is rejected, naming that criterion.

edge_cases.case: An empty edges box is rejected, naming every criterion.
An edges box written none, on a plan with criteria, is rejected.
A split plan's story criterion left out is rejected, naming it.

test_changes.tests/test_handback_check.py::test_well_: The bare review keeps the required boxes now; every other check is unchanged.

answers.why: The 819.1 test now also fails when any reason names a box that is still there.
The 819.4 test now also fails when any reason names a box left clear.
The 819.2 test now rejects edges lines naming no case or reading neither covered nor missing.
